sources.use: Building-specific project description and exterior/interior photographs.
supports: Three-story cast-in-place concrete frame and steel mechanical penthouse are described.
The project description identifies a cantilevered roof/truss expression and Mayflower Red ACM cladding.
Two exposed concrete bridge levels with glass rails and three concrete stairs are described in the atrium.
sources.limits: The published photographs are not orthorectified or dimensioned elevations. They do not register exact facade stations, roof boundaries, floor plans, or stair routes to the local model frame.

sources.use: Qualitative direction/photo cue for red brick, upper glazing, curtainwall, and red roof appearance.
sources.limits: The geotag transforms to approximately [-154.0, 47.3]m in the existing north-oriented local GIS frame, northwest of the official footprint. The photograph has no bearing, calibrated lens, or facade control points. The image supports a general upper glazing band and finish family only; exact facade assignment, R6 band extents, panel rhythm, and dimensions are schematic rather than registered.

sources.use: Retained R5 registration of Purdue GIS feature 642 and 2018 5-ft NDHM height masks into the existing manifest local frame.

registration_summary: R6 preserves the R5 LiDAR/GIS envelope transforms and root. The geotag only establishes that the 2016 photo was captured northwest of the building. Without bearing, calibrated camera parameters, and control points, no exact photo-to-facade registration is claimed.
